column1: # The project's own IDS descriptions for characters newer than the bundled sources.
# BabelStone IDS is the Unicode 16.0 edition (File Date 2025-06-27); Yi Bai's level-1 set is older.
# U+33473 𳑳: Unicode 17.0 CJK Extension J (released 2025-09-09); Unihan 18.0.0 kIRG_VSource VN-F0BEA,
# zi.tools decomposes it as ⿷⿺#(𠃑-一乚)一三 (ids_zi_tools, api/zi, read 2026-10-28); the three-stroke
# group is 己, so the IDS here is ⿷⿺己一三. Editorial.

column3: zi.tools ids_zi_tools ⿷⿺#(𠃑-一乚)一三; Unicode 17.0 U+33473
